title: Vijay Sethupathi Sexual Abuse Allegations: Accuser Ramya Mohan's X Account Deleted? | Tamil Cinema News - News18
text:
Vijay Sethupathi Sexual Abuse Allegations: A few days ago, an X user named Ramya Mohan had accused veteran actor Vijay Sethupathi of sexually exploiting a girl she knew. Ramya mentioned in her X post that drugs and sexual manipulation were rampant practices in Kollywood. However, as soon as Ramya’s accusations started grabbing eyeballs, she deleted her post. Now, even her X account seems to have been deleted. If Ramya Mohan’s account is searched on X, the result reads, “This account doesn’t exist.
Try searching for another." It is unclear whether Ramya’s account has been suspended by X or if she deleted it after making accusations against Vijay Sethupathi. Have a look here:
Ramya’s post mentioned that Vijay Sethupathi had sexually accused a “known face in media". The post read, “@VijaySethuOffl has offered Rs. 2L for ‘caravan favors’, Rs. 50k for ‘drives’ and acts like a saint on social media." The post also mentioned, “This isn’t one story. It’s many, and the media worships these men like they are saints. The drug-sex nexus is real. Not a joke." The post also mentioned that “drugs, manipulation, and transactional exploitation disguised as industry norm" is rampant in Kollywood.
advetisement Meanwhile, speaking to Subhash K Jha from Deccan Chronicle, Vijay Sethupathi has denied the accusations, calling them filthy. Vijay Sethupathi said, “Anyone who knows me even remotely will laugh at this. I know myself too. This kind of filthy accusation can’t upset me. My family and close friends are upset, but I tell them, ‘Let it slide. This woman is obviously doing it to be noticed. She has her few minutes of fame, let her enjoy it.’"
He added, “We’ve complained to cybercrime. I’ve faced all kinds of whispering campaigns for seven years. Such targeting has not affected me so far. It never will." The actor also said that the timing of the allegations is suspicious since his latest film is working well. He said that “jealous elements" are trying to tarnish his image. He added, “In today’s day and age, anyone can say anything about anybody. There are no filters. All you need is an account on social media, and you can write what you like without fear of repercussion."
